title: Self-Awareness and Adolescent Change
summary: Physical, emotional, social and cognitive changes in adolescence, self-awareness and self-esteem, personal values, coping with change, and the transition to the FET phase.

rows: Growth spurts, hormonal changes, changes in body shape, skin and voice
Mood swings, stronger feelings, searching for identity, wanting independence
Friends and peers become more important; first romantic relationships; new roles at home
Thinking becomes more abstract; questioning rules and beliefs; planning for the future
Developing personal values and beliefs, sometimes different from those of parents

notes.text: Understanding your own personality, strengths, weaknesses, feelings, values and motives, and how they affect your behaviour and other people.

items: **Strengths and weaknesses**: identifying them helps you set realistic goals and seek help where needed.
**Self-esteem**: how you value yourself. Healthy self-esteem helps you resist negative pressure and recover from setbacks.
**Values**: principles that guide your choices, such as honesty, respect, responsibility and compassion.

notes.label: Johari window
notes.text: A model of self-awareness with four 'windows': things known to you and others (open), known to others but not to you (blind spot), known to you but hidden from others (hidden), and unknown to everyone (unknown). Feedback and sharing make the open area bigger.

notes.title: Identifying strengths and weaknesses
notes.problem: How can you get an honest view of your strengths?
steps: Reflect on what you do well.

notes.text: Grade 10 brings new subjects, higher expectations and a step towards adulthood. Healthy coping includes planning, asking for help, keeping routines, exercising, talking about feelings and focusing on what you can control.

notes.title: Moving to a new school
notes.problem: List healthy ways of dealing with a move to a new school.
steps: Accept that it will feel strange.
Stay in touch with old friends and speak to a counsellor if needed.
notes.answer: Join in, stay connected and ask for support.

items: Choose friends who respect and support you.
Learn from mistakes instead of seeing them as failures.
Take care of your physical and mental health.
